name: Skrelv's Hive
oracle_text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life and create a 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token with toxic 1 and "This token can't block."
Corrupted — As long as an opponent has three or more poison counters, creatures you control with toxic have lifelink.
blocked_sentences: Corrupted — As long as an opponent has three or more poison counters, creatures you control with toxic have lifelink

needs.what: a static-condition value reading a player's poison counters -- the most among a player spec, e.g. {"max_poison_of": "each_opponent"} beside max_life_of -- so "as long as an opponent has three or more poison counters" is a cmp >= 3. The rest of the card is expressible: the upkeep trigger is lose_life plus create_token phyrexian_mite_1_1_c_toxic, and "creatures you control with toxic" is a grant_keyword lifelink static filtered keywords: ["toxic"]
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The value vocabulary reads life (life_of, max_life_of, min_life_of), counters on objects (counters_on) and event tallies, but nothing reads PlayerState.poison; counters_on selects permanents, not players
